rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Grandiflora.
Registration name: San Antonio ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by David L. Armstrong (United States, 1967).
Introduced in United States by Armstrong Nursery as 'San Antonio'.
rows.Bloom: Scarlet. (Rouge signal fif). Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit: Bushy, upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
